article.title: Lumo Desktop加入連接器、排程與可重用工作指引
article.title_en: Lumo Desktop adds connectors, schedules and reusable instructions
article.summary: Proton推出Windows、macOS及Linux版Lumo Desktop，讓助理連接檔案與工具，並加入排程及技能。
article.summary_en: Proton launched Lumo Desktop on Windows, macOS and Linux with app connections, schedules and Skills.
highlights: 動作可設為自動、需批准或封鎖；已連接工具預設在對話啟用。
排程有獨立權限，技能可保存寫作指引、範本及參考檔案。
highlights_en: Actions can be automatic, approval-based or blocked; connected tools are enabled in conversations by default.
Schedules have their own permissions, while Skills retain instructions, templates and reference files.
article.why: 內容營運可把資料來源、執行時間與寫作規則組成固定流程，團隊可決定哪些步驟自動整理，哪些交予人員批准。
article.why_en: Content operations can define which steps of a recurring source-to-draft process run automatically and which require approval.
article.next_step: 先建立一份定期內容資料摘要，限定可讀取的資料夾，加入品牌寫作範本，並把任何對外動作設為需批准。
article.next_step_en: Limit a recurring content digest to a specific folder, add a brand template and require approval for external actions.
article.detail: 連接器可存取本機工具、Proton Mail Bridge及支援的第三方服務，也可接自設MCP伺服器。技能會按對話需要套用，既有Custom Lumos將遷移成技能。團隊可先分開檢查來源存取和執行動作，再為一項固定摘要安排排程，確認每次產出的來源與格式符合工作要求。
article.detail_en: Connectors support local tools, Proton Mail Bridge, selected third-party services and custom MCP servers. Relevant Skills apply in conversation, and Custom Lumos migrate to Skills. Review source access separately from actions, then inspect each digest's sources and format.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
